channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Week 5 Fixtures Announcement
item.description: Check out the lineup for Week 5 with 6 exciting matches, including 4 home games and 2 away games. Note the changes to club night schedule.

item.title: Week 4 Fixtures
item.description: Join us for an exciting week of 9 matches with our badminton teams, featuring 5 home and 4 away games. Check out the schedule and club night details.

item.title: Week 3 Fixtures: Spooky Week
